summary: The paper measures circulating chemokines and cytokines in IBD; the alias MIF refers to macrophage migration inhibitory factor, not S100A9.

quote: In human colon tumor tissues and in a mouse model of CAC, we found that myeloid progenitors expressing S100A8 and S100A9 infiltrate regions of dysplasia and adenoma.
summary: S100A8/A9-expressing myeloid progenitors infiltrate dysplastic and adenoma regions in human colon tumours and a colitis-associated cancer mouse model; S100A8/A9 binds RAGE and activates NF-kappaB.
The paper concerns MIF (macrophage migration inhibitory factor) knockout and p53; S100A9 is not studied.

quote: Several genes were highly up-regulated in patients with SARS, such as, the genes coding for Lactoferrin, S100A9 and Lipocalin 2.
summary: S100A9 is among genes up-regulated in PBMCs of SARS patients, a non-UC disease, within a 186-gene differential expression profile.
The paper is about the cytokine MIF in experimental colitis; the alias MIF does not refer to S100A9.

quote: S100A8 and S100A9 induced the secretion of cytokines such as IL-6, IL-8, and IL-1β.
summary: Recombinant S100A8 and S100A9 induce IL-6, IL-8 and IL-1β secretion from PBMCs via ROS-dependent NF-κB and NLRP3 inflammasome activation, enhancing inflammatory responses.

quote: The EF-hand proteins S100A8 and S100A9 are important calcium signalling proteins that are involved in wound healing and provide clinically relevant markers of inflammatory processes, such as rheumatoid arthritis and inflammatory bowel disease.
summary: Crystal structure of the S100A8/S100A9 calprotectin heterotetramer; IBD is mentioned only as a context where calprotectin is a marker, with no IBD data.

quote: In particular, S100A9-mediated NOD-like receptor protein 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome activation directs an inflammatory, lytic form of cell death termed pyroptosis that underlies many of the hallmark features of the disease.
summary: Review of inflammatory signaling in myelodysplastic syndromes describing S100A9-driven NLRP3 inflammasome activation and pyroptosis; not about UC.
The paper concerns the MIF receptor complex of CD74 and CXCR4; MIF here is not S100A9.

quote: This review focuses on our current understanding of the pro- and anti-tumorigenic functions of S100A8 and S100A9.
summary: Review of S100A8 and S100A9 roles in tumour growth and metastasis and as cancer biomarkers; no UC-specific content.
The paper evaluates sepsis biomarkers including MIF (macrophage migration inhibitory factor); S100A9 is not studied.

quote: Moreover, we purified S100A8/A9 from the cytoplasmic fraction of neutrophils and found that S100A8/A9 could induce neutrophil activation, including adhesion and CD11b upregulation, indicating that this DAMP might amplify neutrophil activation.
summary: S100A8/A9 is released with NETs and purified S100A8/A9 activates neutrophils (adhesion, CD11b upregulation), suggesting it amplifies neutrophil activation; not tested in colitis.
The glioblastoma review uses P14 as p14ARF (CDKN2A product), not S100A9.

quote: Loss of this autoinhibitory mechanism in vivo results in TNF-α-driven fatal inflammation, as shown by lack of tetramer formation in crossing S100A9-/- mice with 2 independent TNF-α-transgene mouse strains.
summary: S100A8/S100A9 tetramer formation restricts TLR4-dependent alarmin activity locally; S100A9-deficient mice lacking tetramers on a TNF-transgene background develop fatal inflammation, in non-colitis models.
The review is about MIF as a biomarker; the alias MIF does not refer to S100A9.
The review on chronic inflammation and cancer discusses MIF cytokine, not S100A9.

quote: In AD skin lesions, protein and mRNA expression of lipocalin 2 and other innate defense genes (hBD2, elafin, LL37) were reduced compared with psoriasis.
summary: Elafin is named among innate defense genes with reduced expression in atopic dermatitis skin versus psoriasis; no UC data.
PI3 here refers to PI3-K/Akt signaling in PTEN mutant mice, not the elafin gene.
ESI here means electronic supplementary information in a deep learning drug-target paper, not the PI3 gene.

quote: Several atherosclerosis mediators in serum (e.g. E-selectin, PI3/elafin, CCL7, IL-16) correlated with SCORAD, but not BMI.
summary: Serum PI3/elafin is one of several proteins correlating with disease severity in atopic dermatitis; no UC data.
